units.name: Operations Management
units.evidence: Official Research Area page groups Operations Management faculty and identifies an Operations Management Area Coordinator; its remit explicitly covers operational processes, business systems and supply chains. Rice Business describes itself as encompassing Jones Graduate and Virani Undergraduate schools.

units.name: Department of Computational Applied Mathematics & Operations Research (CMOR)
units.school: George R. Brown School of Engineering and Computing
units.evidence: Department homepage displays the full official name and repeatedly uses CMOR. It describes interdisciplinary applied mathematics and operations research with business, finance, energy and healthcare applications; engineering directory establishes the parent school.

decisions.reason: Retain the fully named Operations Management area under the current Rice Business umbrella; page explicitly names area coordinator, not department chair. Engineering operations-research department additionally verified.

branches.conclusion: Full Business overview and Graduate inventory read, six PhD major concentrations. Explicit OM concentration retained; school and degree distinguished from undergraduate Virani and professional/dual degrees.

Current relevant CMOR departmental graduate inventory plus PhD requirements and Industrial Engineering degree overview checked. Research CMOR PhD qualifies OR; professional MIE/MCAAM and interdisciplinary CSE master’s not duplicate doctoral routes.

sources.note: 2026–2027 Computational Applied Mathematics and Operations Research PhD Outcomes and Requirements tabs read. Actual PhD, 90 credits, departmental course programme, qualifying review, original thesis and final public oral examination; en-route MA, 30 credits is not independent PhD.

Current full CMOR departmental overview read, explicit Department of Computational Applied Mathematics and Operations Research chair. MA/PhD concentrates on research; numerical/scientific computing, physical modelling, optimization/decision making and computational stochastics. MIE/MCAAM/MCSE are master’s.

Current full Business overview and Graduate tab read. Actual Jesse H. Jones Graduate School of Business offers Business PhD with six named major concentrations including Operations Management, distinct Virani undergraduate school.

Full Operations Management PhD Outcomes and Requirements tabs read. Actual Business PhD major concentration OM, 90 credits, original oral-defended thesis, core MDP/game/stochastic models, OR/economics, and research in manufacturing, supply chains, energy, healthcare and technology management.

Current Industrial Engineering overview read: exact Master of Industrial Engineering administered by George R. Brown School of Engineering and Computing and overseen by CMOR. Professional master’s not another IE PhD or department.

limitations: Current 2026–2027 source-bounded programme scope, not historical census.
